summary.text: Todd Weiler is a Republican member of the Utah State Senate for District 8, covering parts of Davis and Salt Lake counties, serving since January 13, 2012, and is the Senate Parliamentarian. The Legislature's roster lists him as an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Weiler earned a B.S. from Brigham Young University and a J.D. from the J. Reuben Clark Law School, according to the Utah Legislature's roster.
The roster lists him as a board member of United Way of Salt Lake and Discovery Gateway Children's Museum, as chair-elect of the Council of State Governments West, and as a 2019 Toll Fellow.
